name: Food & drink
title: Food and drink holidays
intro: Street food, markets, cooking classes and long lunches. Here's where to go for a holiday built around eating well, and when to go.

faqs.question: Where is best for food on holiday?
faqs.answer: Tokyo, Bangkok, Penang, Mexico City, Lisbon and Rome are some of the best places in the world to eat, at every budget.

faqs.question: Where is good for a food weekend away?
faqs.answer: Porto, Paris, Copenhagen, Ghent and Kraków are short flights from the UK and easy to eat your way around in a long weekend.

faqs.question: Are food holidays good with fussy eaters?
faqs.answer: Usually. Markets and street food let everyone pick a little of what they like, and most food cities have plenty of simple dishes like pasta, noodles and grilled meat.
